# DEV-76 / CSF-T005 design documentation check

Date: 7 October 2026. Mode: Read. Outcome: preserve the existing design.

Only this temporary report was written. No repository file, design guide,
provider or public site was changed by this pass.

The new documentation pages extend the existing Website. The stylesheet at
HEAD and the working stylesheet have the same original 184 lines; the diff
only adds document styles. The background, main text, font stack, top
navigation, form styles and keyboard focus colour remain as they were.

## Five-line system summary

1. Palette: pale background (#f8fafc), dark text (#172033), quieter navigation text (#526071), light borders (#d6dde7), inherited blue focus (#2563eb), and document links in darker blue (#075985).
2. Type: the existing Inter/system font stack; article text (1.0625rem, line height 1.75); page title (clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem), line height 1.15); navigation and tables (0.9375rem); code blocks (0.875rem, line height 1.6).
3. Layout: article width capped at 72ch, meaning about 72 characters per line; a 17rem desktop sidebar; one column below 52rem; a native collapsible navigation list on phones.
4. Surfaces: plain background, thin borders, rounded code blocks (0.375rem), locally scrolling code and tables, and no added shadows or decorative imagery.
5. Named rules: no existing named visual rules were found and none were invented; preserve authored reading order, ordinary links, clear current-page marking and visible keyboard focus.
